The issuer exhibits solid profitability and operating cash generation with revenue of $1.79B, an EBIT margin of ~18% ($322M), and a healthy equity base of $2.47B. However, leverage is moderately elevated with total liabilities of $5.15B against total assets of $7.61B (67.6% debt/liabilities-to-assets ratio), and current assets of $664M fall slightly short of current liabilities of $800M (working capital deficit). Balancing the strong operating profile and earnings capacity against the leverage and short-term liquidity tight spot places the company solidly in the investment-grade BBB spectrum.

DECISION: BBB
